working_title: Adaptive target resolution under exactly balanced binary queries

headline_results.statement: For even n>=6, max C_F=n-3 under globally exact 50/50 binary unit-cost queries.
headline_results.prior_art_boundary: Generic inclusionwise-minimal separating-family cap n-1 is classical via Bondy; cardinality-constrained and uniform separating systems are prior art.

headline_results.statement: Every cap-saturating minimum resolver has star-edge-star private-pair normal form; rows are forced up to relabeling/complementation.
D_h(n)=max{C_F:C_A<=h}; D3 is fully closed, D4 is closed through saturation, selected D5 rows are sharp.
Every query may be globally exactly 50/50 balanced while C_F/C_A >= 2^d/(d+1) -> infinity.
